content.text: severe alkalosis (ex, pH > 7.6) sometimes needs more urgent correction; acetazolamide 250 to 375 mg PO or IV QD or BID ↑HCO3− excretion but may also ↑urinary K+ & PO4− losses; vol-overloaded pts w diuretic-induced alkalosis & those w posthypercapnic alkalosis may esp benefit

CI: hypersensitivity (a sulfonamide derivative: cross-sensitivity w sulfonamides poss); CI: ↓Na and/or K · marked kidney or liver dz · adrenal failure · hyperchloremic acidosis · cirrhosis (hepatic encephalopathy risk). Rare fatal sulfonamide rxns (SJS/TEN · fulminant hepatic necrosis · agranulocytosis · aplastic anemia · anaphylaxis): stop @ signs of hypersensitivity. Caution w ↑dose ASA (anorexia · tachypnea · lethargy · met acidosis · coma & death reported). Can cause hyponatremia · hypokalemia & met acidosis: check lytes periodically. Baseline CBC & PLT, then @ regular intervals
